description: Aggregate confirmed HUD FHA multifamily mortgage maturities by holder, state, or maturity month for an exact date window. Returns mortgage count, unpaid principal balance, and units with the monthly HUD snapshot provenance. Use this for 'which FHA lenders have maturities in 2027?' or 'FHA maturity exposure by state'. It does not estimate default risk, ownership, borrower intent, or refinancing likelihood.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: hud_fha_lender_exposure
